To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
horizontal gene transfer of stress tolerance genes is achieved under lab conditions.
plasmid transfer through conjugation and transformation can generate multiple stress tolerant strains, which can be utilized for bioremediation.
the plasmids of heavy metal and antibiotic resistant bacterial strains are transferred through conjugation and transformation.
In summary, our research is concerned with
horizontal gene transfer of stress resistant genes through plasmids.
the horizontal transfer of plasmides carrying multiple stress tolerance genes.
horizontal gene transfer of resistance genes through plsmid transport.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the horizontal gene transfer of stress tolerance genes is a natural phenomenon and it is very likely that it is occurring in nature.
the plasmid-determinded stress tolerance genes can be transferred through plasmid conjugation and/or transformation, resulting in the generation of multiple stress tolerant strains.
the plasmid transfer of genes conferring resistance to heavy metals and antimicrobials was achieved through transformation as well as conjugation, under lab conditions.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
, the transfer of stress tolerant plasmids through conjugation and transformation can lead to the formation of multiple stress tolerance in a bacterial strain.
plasmid transfer of stress resistance is an important factor for survival of microorganisms in contaminated environment.
the stress tolerance genes can be transferred through horizontal gene transfer, and the stress tolerance can also be transferred through plasmid transfer.
The main takeaway from our work is that
plasmid-mediated stress tolerance can occur naturally and it has a significant role in horizontal gene transfer.
the stress tolerance genes are horizontally transferable through plasmid and can be transferred to different strains.
plasmids can be transferred between bacterial species, and the genes on the plasmid are not necessarily linked.
